title: Coast Guard Cutter Isaac Mayo crew rescues stranded migrants
description: U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Isaac Mayo's crew rescues nine Cubans and a dog stranded on Water Cay, Bahamas, Oct. 12, 2022. U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Manowar's crew transferred the people and dog to Bahamian authorities on Oct. 14, 2022. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Lt. Alex Cordes)
